_note: Two real leads from the same corpus, same 8 protocols, opposite outcomes. Identities are replaced by neutral labels; the counts are the real ones. This is the axis the core decision controls: how much of what was asked could actually be sourced.

_provenance.produced_by: the two extremes of the completeness distribution over fully-enriched leads

runs.note: a company with public filings and press coverage: nearly every required field resolved
a company with little public footprint: the workflow completed all 8 protocols but recorded what it could not find instead of filling it in

what_this_shows: the workflow does not fail when a company is hard to research - it produces a thinner, honestly-marked report. The validator's completeness score is what tells a human which of the two they are holding.
